notes.title: Network Refactor and Player Improvements
notes.content:
Massive change to the network of item system, so smooth sync of items is now working in multiplayer. 
Everything should be working as intended, Keys opening Doors, Enemies Roaming, and gathering cores to finish a round.

I also fixed the player camera issue where it would be jittery/spin like crazy on different computers! This was a big one, as I wanted to properly show the camera where the head should be, not just floating incorrectly

notes.title: Immersive Player Camera
notes.content: Camera should now follow the player head when running and moving, making it immersive!

notes.title: The lobby is now connected to the station
notes.content: Set it up so that the lobby area is connected to the space station, now when you start the game, a door will open up!

notes.content:
When all players are dead, the game will take you back to the lobby now.
Ragdoll Camera improvement, should now look at the ragdoll on death, slight jittery atm, but it's working.
Keys shouldn't be culled (appear to have disappear from hand), when moving between rooms.
